units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:1">Kil. V, 1</cite> <he>כרם ד׳</he> a sparsely planted vineyard; Y. ib. 29ᵈ bot. <he>ד׳ בגפנים וכ׳</he> poor concerning vines, and rich as regards labor (requiring as much labor as a thickly planted vineyard).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:6">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00807"><he>דִּלְדֵּל</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דַּלִּים</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:4">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00743"><he>גימ״ל</he></cite>. Tanḥ. B’har 3 <he>ד׳ ממע״ט</he> they were void of good deeds.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:2">Num. R. s. 5</cite> <he>ד׳ במניין</he> small in numbers; a. fr.—<he>דַּלֵּי דַלּוּת</he>, v. <cite ref="D00824"><he>דַּלּוּת</he></cite>.
